title: Trace propagation missing across billing and checkout services
comments: Investigated distributed tracing blind spots between billing RPCs and the payment gateway. We reviewed Jaeger vs OpenTelemetry SDKs. Alice Vance decided we will adopt OpenTelemetry across all microservices to standardize W3C trace context propagation and export metrics to Prometheus.

title: Routine quarterly maintenance on log analytics cluster
comments: Completed routine node rolling maintenance on logging-es-prod. While addressing Lucene memory pressure, Carlos Mendez approved upgrading the Elasticsearch cluster to version 8.13 across all logging nodes to enable native vector indexing and lower heap usage.

title: Intermittent TCP reset errors during batch warehouse sync
comments: Captured tcpdump traces on egress gateways showing AWS NAT gateway dropping idle connections after 350s. Dave Miller concluded after packet analysis that we must reduce TCP keepalive probe timeout to 60 seconds on all egress gateways to preserve connection health.

title: Memory leak alert on notification worker pod replica 4
comments: Pod was crashing with OOMKilled code 137 under peak load. Profiling traced the issue to an unclosed XML parser buffer in the email template renderer. Bumped the pod memory limit from 512Mi to 1Gi and restarted the deployment. Memory has stabilized.
